description: Exploit and crux test (W5: does a math-identical change keep the tip's per-seed outcomes?). Base: the current tip (E027, or the H2.6.2 successor if kept). Change only systems work in prepare, keeping every number bit-identical. (1) Move the training images to the GPU as uint8 and do the float conversion, normalization and channels_last/fp16 cast on the GPU, in the same op order and dtype the CPU path uses now. (2) In build, run prepare's GPU kernels once on synthetic uint8 tensors of the real shape: the whitening patch extraction and eigendecomposition, the normalization and the allocations. This removes trial 0's 0.21 s first-call cost. The whitening is still computed from the same images as now; do not subsample. Before launching, check offline with torch.equal that the normalized train tensor and the whitening weights equal the current ones. If they don't, adjust the op order until they do, or abandon. Record per-trial prepare time.
